description: This file defines the AuthProvider class, a state management class for handling user authentication, including login, registration, initialization, and logout functionalities for a Flutter frontend application.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A provider class extending ChangeNotifier to manage authentication state, including user info and login/logout procedures.

methods.name: _setLoading
methods.description: Sets the internal loading state and triggers notifyListeners.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the user session by loading the token and fetching current user info.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login with provided email and password, updates user info.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with provided details.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user by clearing tokens and user state.
